title: Bitcoin price may bottom at $88K next cycle if last CME gap stays open
summary: Bitcoin filled one of two new futures gaps with a trip below $90,000 as analysis predicted a potential bottom level for the next BTC price cycle.

title: CZ-backed YZi Labs escalates fight over CEA’s ‘poison pill’ and BNB treasury strategy
summary: YZi Labs is challenging CEA Industries’ newly adopted poison pill and bylaw changes, accusing the board of entrenchment and misrepresenting its commitment to a BNB treasury.

title: BitMine buys $105M Ether to kick off 2026, still holds $915M in cash
summary: The largest corporate ETH holder started 2026 with a $105 million Ether purchase, while surpassing $2.87 billion in staked Ether, seeking to generate passive yield on its holdings.

title: India tax authorities warn crypto undermines tax enforcement
summary: Officials told a parliamentary panel that private wallets, offshore exchanges and cross-border DeFi activity make tracking taxable crypto income difficult.

title: XRP ETFs notch first outflows as nearly $600M exits Bitcoin, Ether funds
summary: XRP ETFs logged their first net outflow day since launch, breaking a multi-week inflow streak after more than $1 billion poured into the funds.

title: Morgan Stanley’s Bitcoin ETF could offer strategic value beyond inflows, analysts say
summary: Analysts say the bank’s late entry into spot Bitcoin ETFs may still carry reputational and strategic upside across its brokerage and crypto ambitions.

title: Zcash devs split from Electric Coin Company, plan to create new firm
summary: Electric Coin Company CEO Josh Swihart says the firm's entire team left and will start a new company over disagreements with the nonprofit board that supports Zcash.

title: AI giant Anthropic raising $10B at $350B valuation: Report
summary: Claude maker Anthropic is aiming to nearly double its valuation to $350 billion, with The Wall Street Journal reporting a planned $10 billion raise.

title: Memecoin social buzz grows as traders return to risk assets
summary: Memecoins fell 65% over 2025 as risk-taking behavior dropped among traders, but the tokens are seeing gains as positive sentiment returns to crypto.

title: Solana Mobile to launch SKR token for Seeker phone on Jan. 21
summary: Solana Mobile will airdrop up to 20% of SKR tokens to users of its Seeker phone on Jan. 21, and introduce so-called Guardians to secure the network.
